objective: Read-only cross-eval attestation: ALL committed MCP manifest head-pin eval artifacts (B112 + B113 + B114) must share ONE committed_sha256 equal to the live nested-repo HEAD blob of the B110 manifest, so that when the manifest HEAD blob legitimately advances a single canonical refresh path updates the whole eval set atomically and no committed eval can lag the others. Divergence across the eval set is rejected non-zero.

source_provenance.measured_via: git show HEAD:<manifest_rel> (working-tree-immune, not a git-clean check)

teeth.lagging_eval: A controlled temp-copy of the eval set in which exactly ONE eval's committed_sha256 is frozen to an old value (simulating a manifest recommit whose autorefresh missed that eval) is REJECTED non-zero, because the set is no longer unanimous and no longer equals the live HEAD blob.
teeth.attestation_signature: The attestation signature is sha256 over the sorted '<eval_rel>:<committed_sha256>' lines of the whole eval set; the test recomputes it from the on-disk evals and asserts identity, so any silent per-eval drift changes the signature and fails the round-trip.
teeth.git_clean_false_fail_trap: The manifest HEAD blob is measured via `git show HEAD:<rel>`; an additively-patched (dirty) manifest working tree does not change the measured blob sha, so the attestation is patch-state-independent and a naive git-clean check would false-FAIL.

readonly_proof.scratch_isolation: all scratch in a private mktemp dir cleaned in a trap; per-test temp git repos; no shared fixed-path writes

idempotence.note: Re-running the attestation over the unmodified committed eval set yields the identical attestation_signature and verdict; the check reads-only and derives its result solely from committed evidence + the live HEAD blob, so it is deterministic and re-runnable.

neural_bridge_priority.note: ABCR/validator drift-protection tooth over the executor surface: it attests that the committed head-pin eval SET stays consistent with the live HEAD manifest blob. No regex/keyword/table cue router is introduced as launch or route authority; adapter/runner/topic launch SELECTION remains the learned-router target.
